statement: For every finite base field F, every field extension L/F and every general Weierstrass model, actual q-Frobenius on actual curve points fixes P iff P is in the actual base-change image of a point over F. The same binding proves preservation of actual r-torsion and its rational-subset iff Frobeniusidentity criterion, and directly negates identity on actual geometric3-torsion of the nonsingular F7curve y²=x³+3x+2with9rationalpoints although3|q−1. This targets removal of BKexclusion, not the qualified theorem.
